DUCKDB_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install DUCKDB. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.

DUCKDB_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading duckdb binary or archive artifacts.

DUCKDB_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying duckdb available remote releases.

DUCKDB_VERSION.description: Specific version of duckdb to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
